Crafted by Inscription

This list contains the highest DPS setup with farmable gear from Season 2 Mythic+ Dungeons.

This list is by no means a replacement for simming yourself. Depending on your previous Great Vault choices and the gear you have available to yourself, your BiS gear might look different than this list in some spots.

FAQWhich Tier Set Pieces Do I Want?
For Midnight Season 2, the pieces you convert keep their stats and any cantrip effects. This functionally means that you should convert whatever slots you get at a high item level first. There is no benefit to one slot over another. You should aim to convert any 4 of these 5 items:
  • Head: Worldroot Canopy from Blinding Vale
  • Shoulders: Brood Cleanser's Amice from Temple of Sethraliss
  • Chest: Robes of the Reborn Serpent from Temple of Sethraliss
  • Hands: Handwraps of Oscillating Polarity from Temple of Sethraliss
  • Legs: Wind Soarer's Breeches from Ruby Life Pools
TipsWhich Dungeons Should I Farm?
If you have limited time to play the game, we recommend to farm the following dungeons:
  • Altar of Fangs: Your main hand weapon, a trinket, and a handful of decent options to other pieces presented.
  • Temple of Sethraliss: High budget pieces and a well statted staff to use while you try and get your MH/OH combo.
  • Murder Row: BiS trinket.
